items.title: Portnoy Law Firm Announces Class Action on Behalf of Futu Holdings Limited Investors
items.summary: Futu Holdings Limited faces a class action lawsuit alleging the company made false statements about its compliance with China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) requirements. The company allegedly conducted securities, public fund sales, and futures business in mainland China without proper licenses. On May 22, 2026, Futu disclosed a CSRC notification proposing penalties totaling approximately RMB1.85 billion (~$271 million), causing the stock to fall over 27%. The lawsuit covers investors who purchased securities between May 24, 2023 and May 27, 2026.

items.title: SueWallSt Reminds Shareholders of a Lead Plaintiff Deadline of August 25, 2026 in Futu Holdings Limited Lawsuit - FUTU

The CSRC proposed a RMB 1.85 billion penalty in May 2026, causing FUTU stock to plunge 27.5% in a single session. Investors who purchased FUTU securities between May 24, 2023 and May 27, 2026 may be eligible for compensation, with a lead plaintiff deadline of August 25, 2026.

The company failed to disclose non-compliance with China Securities Regulatory Commission requirements, unlicensed business operations in mainland China, and the risk of significant regulatory penalties. On May 28, 2026, Futu disclosed proposed penalties totaling approximately RMB1.85 billion, causing the stock to decline 4.8%.
